title: Newmark Arranges $24.5 Million Fannie Mae Refinancing for Lakewood, Colorado Apartments
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged a $24.5 million refinancing for The Heights by Marston Lake, a 220-unit garden-style multifamily community in Lakewood, Colorado. The financing was secured on behalf of Urban Inc.
